summary_en: This phase 2 study tests tafasitamab and rituximab as a treatment for newly diagnosed follicular lymphoma. Both drugs are given through an IV, with rituximab on day 1 of each 28-day cycle and tafasitamab on days 1, 8, 15 and 22 in cycles 1 to 3, then on days 1 and 15 in later cycles, for up to 12 cycles unless the disease progresses or toxicity is unacceptable. The main outcome is not stated in the record; the study is a phase 2 trial.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa tafasitamab y rituximab como tratamiento para el linfoma folicular de diagnóstico reciente. Ambos medicamentos se administran por vena: rituximab el día 1 de cada ciclo de 28 días, y tafasitamab los días 1, 8, 15 y 22 en los ciclos 1 a 3, y después los días 1 y 15, por hasta 12 ciclos, salvo que la enfermedad progrese o la toxicidad sea inaceptable. El resultado principal no se indica en el registro; el estudio es de fase 2.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older with histologically confirmed follicular lymphoma, grade 1, 2, 3A or classic.
Newly diagnosed and meeting at least one listed criterion for starting therapy, such as large nodes, B symptoms or low blood counts.
Measurable disease on CT or FDG-PET scan.
ECOG performance status of 2 or less.
Blood counts, liver and kidney function within stated limits; willing to use highly effective contraception if able to have children.
not_for: Known central nervous system involvement by lymphoma.
Prior monoclonal antibody use within 4 weeks before the first dose.
